acceptance: Private cache values cannot be read through shared manifests, artifact IDs or cross-tenant cache side channels.

positive.fixture: private artifacts sealed with tenant-keyed identifiers; raw scan of the database, its journal and every object finds no plaintext, no plaintext hash and no key bytes; private bundle records are sealed; cache values sealed under opaque names

negative.fixture: same content has unrelated identifiers and bytes in two tenants; plaintext hash is not an identifier; an object moved to another tenant fails to open; a bundle opens only under the tenant's keys; a noisy tenant cannot evict another's entries; transplanted and altered cache entries are dropped

versions.primitive: Private artifact identifiers change from the plaintext SHA-256 to a keyed value when a sealer is configured; public artifacts unchanged.

security_and_source_permissions: Keys are derived per tenant; the key file is written 0600 and refused if group or world readable; no key material in any store.
performance_memory_storage: Sealing adds 17 bytes per private artifact.
known_limitations: The decoded-contract cache in backend/execution is process-wide and keyed by content (VSF-B15-T06)
Rewrap under a new key and moving a tenant's keys between installations are queued (VSF-B14-T07)
Lengths and provenance are not hidden
